name: Update GC balance when making multiple payments using 2 GCs

steps.name: Given I am on the HOME page
When I clock in the timesheet with PIN "8526"
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('8', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('5', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('2', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('6', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title') }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'CONFIRM', exact: true })
And I wait for the page fully loaded
Then I should see the employee "Hung" in the employee list
When I add the "Pedicure" service to my cart
Then I should see my cart showing 1 item added
When I click on the total price of "Pedicure"
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
Click locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
When I click on the "Pay" button
When I select the "Gift" payment type
When I fill the last 4 digits of card number "0157"
And I wait for the page fully loaded
And I click on the "OK" button
And I wait for the page fully loaded
Then I should see the payment history "Gift (0157)$10.00 " visible
When I select the "Gift" payment type
And I fill the last 4 digits of card number "01578"
And I wait for the page fully loaded
And I click on the "OK" button
And I wait for the page fully loaded
When I click on the "Close Ticket" button
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: 'Close Ticket', exact: true })
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Close Ticket', exact: true })
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
Given I am on the GIFT_CARD_BALANCE page
Then I should see the first date is today in the gift card detail list
And I should see the first type "Redeem" in the gift card detail list
And I should see the first amount "($10.00)" in the gift card detail list
Then I should see the first date is today in the gift card detail list
And I should see the first type "Redeem" in the gift card detail list
And I should see the first amount "($35.80)" in the gift card detail list
When I back to HOME page
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
When I select the "CLOSED TICKET" tab
And I wait for the page fully loaded
When I reopen to void ticket with payment amount "$45.80"

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$45.80' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first()

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$45.80' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()

Click locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$45.80' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()
Then I should be redirected to HOME page
And I select the "CLOSED TICKET" tab
And I wait for the page fully loaded
And I wait for the page fully loaded
And I click on the first row for payment "$45.80"
And I click the Delete ticket button
Then I should see a popup dialog with title 'Confirm Delete'
When I click on the "confirm" button in the popup dialog
When I clock out the timesheet with PIN "8526"

Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('5', { exact: true })
